0022600145.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-3) host the Sacramento Kings (0-4) in their fifth game of the season, with New Orleans on a three-game losing streak and 14th in the West while Sacramento, on a four-game skid, sits 15th. The teams have yet to meet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans won the season series 2-1, though their most recent meeting was a 117-113 loss in Sacramento on April 3, 2026. The Pelicans are without Yves Missi (knee bruise), who averages 9.5 points and 19.6 minutes per game this season, while the Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee).
